## Binomial Coefficient

The binomial coefficient is defined as 

$$
\begin{pmatrix} n \\ k \end{pmatrix} := \frac{n!}{k!(n-k)!}
$$
The binomial coefficient "n over k" helps us to choose all possible combinations in a set $n$ given a subset of elements $k$ respecting that an element can only be chosen once. This is also the reason for the use of the factorial.
